subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should the fix stop at a validated built-in adapter upgrade with an explicit `CODEX_PATH` workaround, or should acpx also automatically select a system Codex when the bundled runtime fails?
rationale: The adapter upgrade directly fixes the reproduced regression, while automatic fallback creates a lasting convention about runtime selection, version ownership, and silent behavior changes.

options.title: Upgrade and document
options.body: Bump to a validated adapter release, preserve explicit overrides, and document recovery without silently changing runtime selection.

options.title: Add automatic fallback
options.body: Also detect a usable system Codex and inject `CODEX_PATH` after bundled-runtime failure, accepting the version and reproducibility tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Upgrade and document
recommendation.body: Bump to a validated adapter release, preserve explicit overrides, and document recovery without silently changing runtime selection.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Codex adapter and session-config work is the strongest available feature-history signal for deciding the permanent harness contract.
